title: Break large build methods into small widgets
guideline: Extract StatelessWidget/StatelessWidget classes instead of deeply nested inline builder trees

title: Scope state management to what actually needs it
guideline: Use local setState for simple widget state; reach for Provider/Riverpod/Bloc only for shared state

title: Use ListView.builder for long/lazy lists
guideline: Avoid building a full Column of children for large lists; use builder constructors for lazy rendering

title: Centralize styling in ThemeData
guideline: Define colors/typography once in ThemeData/TextTheme instead of hardcoding styles per widget

title: Use Keys for widgets that need identity across rebuilds
guideline: Provide ValueKey/ObjectKey for list items so Flutter can correctly diff reordered widgets

title: Add Semantics labels for custom-drawn widgets
guideline: Wrap icon-only or custom-painted controls in Semantics(label: ...) for screen readers

title: Use MediaQuery/LayoutBuilder for responsive layout
guideline: Adapt layout to available width instead of hardcoding sizes for a single device class
